home.title: Secret Wishlist
home.subtitle: Create groups for your celebrations and choose between two game modes:

anonymousWishlist.title: Anonymous Wishlist
anonymousWishlist.description: Add gifts to your list and see an anonymous list of all gifts without knowing who asked for what.

secretSanta.title: Secret Santa
secretSanta.description: The classic game where each person gifts to someone specific. Automatic draw and email notifications.

gameModes.title: Two Game Modes
gameModes.description: Choose between Anonymous Wishlist or Secret Santa with automatic draw

customThemes.title: Custom Themes
customThemes.description: The app changes theme based on the celebration type

notifications.title: Smart Notifications
notifications.description: Receive email notifications about gift changes and matchings

step1.title: Create a group
step1.description: Define the name, celebration type, and start date

step2.title: Invite your friends
step2.description: Share the unique group link with your family or friends

step3.title: Add your gifts
step3.description: Each member adds the gifts they want to their personal list

step4.title: Buy anonymous gifts
step4.description: See the shuffled group list and mark the ones you'll buy, without anyone knowing what you purchased

groups.title: My Groups
groups.noGroups: You don't have any groups yet
groups.noGroupsDescription: Create a new group or wait to be invited to one.

anonymous.title: Anonymous Wishlist
anonymous.description: In this mode, group members can:

features.feature1: Create their own wishlist of desired gifts
features.feature2: View an anonymous list of all group gifts
features.feature3: Select which gifts they want to buy (without revealing their identity)
features.feature4: The wishlist becomes visible on the event start date

anonymous.ideal: Perfect for events where everyone wants to surprise each other with gifts.

secretSanta.title: Secret Santa

features.feature1: Members join the group until the start date
features.feature2: The group creator performs the draw on the start date
features.feature3: Each person is randomly paired with another
features.feature4: Each participant can only see who they're buying for
features.feature5: Once the draw is done, no more people can join
features.feature6: Everyone receives an email informing them of their match

secretSanta.ideal: Ideal for budget-limited events where each person only gifts to one specific person.
